# DejaVu Sans Mono

The monospace font of the NetSurf browser (`C:\Windows\Fonts`, rendered at
run time by `userland/netsurf/font_nova.c`): **DejaVu Sans Mono 2.37**
Regular and Bold, unmodified.  DejaVu fonts are based on Bitstream Vera and
are distributed under the Bitstream Vera licence with public-domain
changes (see `LICENSE`).

Source: https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/ (as packaged by Debian/Ubuntu,
`fonts-dejavu-mono` 2.37).
